items.title: India to Implement Ayushman Bharat Scheme in West Bengal
items.whyInNews: The West Bengal government is set to implement the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) scheme, becoming the 36th state/union territory to do so. The scheme aims to provide health insurance coverage to economically vulnerable families.
items.summary: The Ayushman Bharat scheme was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2018, with the goal of providing health insurance coverage to over 100 million families. West Bengal's implementation of the scheme is expected to benefit millions of people in the state. The scheme provides an annual health insurance cover of Rs 5 lakh per family, and has already been implemented in 35 other states and union territories.
